name: Air crossing - a sealed rock room no ground unit could ever leave
notes: A flying unit (unit.ravel.buzzard, layer "air") starts walled into a 1x1 rock room a ground unit placed on the same tile would be entombed in for the rest of the Pulse (scenario/load.ts still refuses to place a ground entity on impassable terrain, but a sealed room reachable only through rock is a case the loader cannot catch - it is a movement claim, not a placement one). The buzzard flies straight out on its very first move and crosses more rock reaching the trooper waiting to the east - proving maskForActor's terrain: "ignore" for air (src/pulse/shared.ts) end to end, in a real Pulse, rather than only in the unit test that exercises the mask directly (tests/grid.test.ts).
